description: Tool to perform intelligent graph-based website crawling with parallel path exploration and content extraction. Use when you need to traverse and extract content from multiple pages of a website following specific patterns or instructions. Supports depth/breadth controls, domain filtering, and natural language instructions for guided crawling.

url.title: Url
url.description: Root URL to begin the crawl. Can be provided with or without protocol (e.g., 'docs.tavily.com' or 'https://docs.tavily.com').

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Total number of links to process before stopping the crawl.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format of the extracted content: 'markdown' or 'text'.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Maximum wait time in seconds for the crawl operation. Range: 10-150.

max_depth.title: Max Depth
max_depth.description: Maximum crawl depth from base URL. Range: 1-5. Depth of 1 means only direct links from the root URL.

max_breadth.title: Max Breadth
max_breadth.description: Maximum number of links to follow per page level.

instructions.title: Instructions
examples: Find all pages about the Python SDK
Get all blog posts about AI
instructions.description: Natural language guidance for the crawler to find specific pages or content. Using instructions raises the cost to 2 credits per 10 pages. Example: 'Find all pages about the Python SDK'.

select_paths.title: Select Paths
select_paths.description: List of regex patterns for specific URL paths to include. Example: ['/docs/.*', '/api/.*'].

exclude_paths.title: Exclude Paths
exclude_paths.description: List of regex patterns to skip certain URL paths. Example: ['/admin/.*', '/private/.*'].

extract_depth.title: Extract Depth
extract_depth.description: Extraction level for content: 'basic' for standard extraction or 'advanced' for deeper analysis.

include_usage.title: Include Usage
include_usage.description: If true, includes credit usage information in the response.

allow_external.title: Allow External
allow_external.description: If true, includes links to external domains in the crawl.

include_images.title: Include Images
include_images.description: If true, includes images in the crawl results.

select_domains.title: Select Domains
select_domains.description: List of regex patterns for domain filtering. Only URLs matching these patterns will be crawled.

exclude_domains.title: Exclude Domains
exclude_domains.description: List of regex patterns to exclude certain domains from the crawl.

include_favicon.title: Include Favicon
include_favicon.description: If true, includes favicon URLs in the results.

chunks_per_source.title: Chunks Per Source
chunks_per_source.description: Maximum content snippets per source (max 500 chars each). Range: 1-5.

name: Tavily crawl

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: The number of API credits consumed by this crawl request.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Credit consumption details. Only included when include_usage is set to true.

baseUrl.title: Base Url
baseUrl.description: The root URL that was crawled.

results.title: Results
results.description: Array of extracted content from crawled URLs.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL of the crawled page.

favicon.title: Favicon
favicon.description: The favicon URL for the page. Only included when include_favicon is set to true.

rawContent.title: Raw Content
rawContent.description: The extracted content from the page in the specified format (markdown or text).

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not

description: Extract web page content from specified URLs using Tavily, with optional image extraction and query-based content reranking. Managed Tavily requests support basic extraction depth only.

urls.title: Urls
urls.description: URL(s) to extract content from. Can be a single URL string or a list of URL strings.

query.title: Query
query.description: User intent for reranking extracted content chunks. Helps prioritize the most relevant extracted content based on the query.

format.title: Format
format.description: Content format for extraction: 'markdown' or 'text'. Default is 'markdown'.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Maximum wait time in seconds for the extraction request. Must be between 1.0 and 60.0 seconds. Default is 30.0.

extract_depth.title: Extract Depth
extract_depth.description: Extraction depth level: 'basic' for standard extraction or 'advanced' for more in-depth extraction. Default is 'basic'.

include_usage.title: Include Usage
include_usage.description: If true, includes credit usage information in the response.

include_images.title: Include Images
include_images.description: If true, includes a list of image URLs found in the extracted content.

include_favicon.title: Include Favicon
include_favicon.description: If true, includes the favicon URL for each result.

chunks_per_source.title: Chunks Per Source
chunks_per_source.description: Maximum number of relevant chunks to extract per source. Must be between 1 and 5. Default is 3.

name: Tavily extract

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL of the image found in the extracted content.

creditsUsed.title: Credits Used
creditsUsed.description: Number of API credits consumed by this extraction request.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Credit usage information. Only included when include_usage is set to true.

results.title: Results
results.description: List of successfully extracted content from the provided URLs.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request, useful for support and debugging purposes.

responseTime.title: Response Time
responseTime.description: The time in seconds it took to complete the extraction request.

failedResults.title: Failed Results
failedResults.description: List of URLs that could not be processed, along with error details.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL of the extracted content source.

images.title: Images
images.description: List of image URLs found in the content. Only included when include_images is set to true.

favicon.title: Favicon
favicon.description: The favicon URL of the source. Only included when include_favicon is set to true.

rawContent.title: Raw Content
rawContent.description: The extracted content in the specified format (markdown or text).

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL that failed to be processed.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message describing why the URL processing failed.

description: Tool to map a website and discover its pages. Use when you need to scan a website and get a structured list of URLs/pages it contains without extracting full content.

url.title: Url
url.description: The root URL to begin mapping (e.g., 'docs.tavily.com'). This is the starting point from which the crawler will discover and map pages.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Total number of links to process before stopping. Minimum is 1. Default is 50.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for the mapping to complete. Range: 10-150. Default is 150.

max_depth.title: Max Depth
max_depth.description: How far from the base URL the crawler explores. Range: 1-5. Default is 1.

max_breadth.title: Max Breadth
max_breadth.description: The number of links to follow per page level. Minimum is 1. Default is 20.

instructions.title: Instructions
examples: Map all blog posts and articles
instructions.description: Natural language directions for the crawler to guide its exploration. Using this parameter raises the cost to 2 credits per 10 pages instead of 1.

select_paths.title: Select Paths
select_paths.description: List of regex patterns for specific URL paths to include (e.g., '/docs/.*' to only include documentation paths).

exclude_paths.title: Exclude Paths
exclude_paths.description: List of regex patterns to skip certain URL paths (e.g., '/admin/.*' to exclude admin pages).

include_usage.title: Include Usage
include_usage.description: If true, includes credit usage details in the response. Default is false.

allow_external.title: Allow External
allow_external.description: If true, includes external domain links in the results. Default is true.

select_domains.title: Select Domains
select_domains.description: List of regex patterns for domain targeting. Only URLs matching these domain patterns will be included.

exclude_domains.title: Exclude Domains
exclude_domains.description: List of regex patterns to exclude certain domains from the mapping results.

name: Tavily map website

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: The number of API credits consumed by this request.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Credit usage details. Only included when include_usage parameter is set to true.

results.title: Results
results.description: List of discovered URLs from the mapped website.

base_url.title: Base Url
base_url.description: The mapped root URL that was provided in the request.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: A unique identifier for the request, useful for support and debugging purposes.

response_time.title: Response Time
response_time.description: The time in seconds it took to complete the mapping request.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not

description: Search the web via Tavily with controls for search depth, result count, and domain filtering. Results can include images, an answer, and raw page content. Managed requests support basic depth only.

query.title: Query
examples: best practices for REST API design
query.description: The search query string to find relevant information online. No native date-filter exists; embed time hints directly in the query string. For broad coverage, issue multiple focused queries rather than one broad query.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return. Large values combined with include_raw_content=true produce very large payloads.

search_depth.title: Search Depth
search_depth.description: Specifies search depth: 'basic' (standard) or 'advanced' (in-depth; costs twice the basic price).

include_answer.title: Include Answer
include_answer.description: If true, attempts to include a direct answer to the query (suitable for factual questions) in search results. The answer field can be null; treat response_data.results array as primary evidence.

include_images.title: Include Images
include_images.description: If true, includes links to relevant images in search results.

exclude_domains.title: Exclude Domains
exclude_domains.description: A list of domain names (e.g., `['exclude.com', 'othersite.net']`) to exclude from search results; results from these domains will be filtered out.

include_domains.title: Include Domains
include_domains.description: A list of specific domain names (e.g., `['example.com', 'website.org']`) to restrict the search to; only results from these domains are returned.

include_raw_content.title: Include Raw Content
include_raw_content.description: If true, includes raw content from visited websites (e.g., unprocessed HTML or text) in search results. Without this, results may be short snippets that omit critical detail.

name: Tavily search

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL of the search result.

score.title: Score
score.description: The relevance score of the search result, typically ranging from 0 to 1.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title of the search result.

content.title: Content
content.description: A short description or excerpt from the search result.

favicon.title: Favicon
favicon.description: The URL of the website's favicon. Only included when include_favicon parameter is set to true.

rawContent.title: Raw Content
rawContent.description: The cleaned and extracted HTML content from the page. Only included when include_raw_content parameter is set to true.

publishedDate.title: Published Date
publishedDate.description: The publication date of the source in GMT format (e.g., 'Tue, 11 Mar 2025 17:00:00 GMT'). Only available when the search topic is set to 'news'.

searchDepth.title: Search Depth
searchDepth.description: The automatically selected search depth level (e.g., 'basic', 'advanced').

query.title: Query
query.description: The search query that was executed.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: An LLM-generated short answer to the user's query. Only included when include_answer parameter is set to true, basic, or advanced.

images.title: Images
images.description: A list of query-related image URLs.

results.title: Results
results.description: A list of sorted search results, ranked by relevancy.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request, useful for support and debugging purposes.

responseTime.title: Response Time
responseTime.description: The time in seconds it took to complete the search request.

autoParameters.title: Auto Parameters
autoParameters.description: Information about automatically configured parameters. Only shown when auto_parameters is set to true.

followUpQuestions.title: Follow Up Questions
followUpQuestions.description: A list of suggested follow-up questions related to the query. Currently in development and may return null.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
